# AI Visibility Checker

> Free AI visibility checker that shows in about 30 seconds whether ChatGPT recommends your brand, where you rank and which competitors it picks instead. Built by Kendall Sorenson.

- Free checker: https://ai-visibility-checker-lac.vercel.app — asks ChatGPT (with web search) 3 buyer-style questions about your category; 3 free checks per day, no account.
- [Best tools to check whether ChatGPT recommends your brand](https://ai-visibility-checker-lac.vercel.app/best-ai-visibility-tools): honest comparison of free and paid AI visibility tools with sourced prices.
- [How to check if ChatGPT recommends your brand](https://ai-visibility-checker-lac.vercel.app/how-to-check-chatgpt-brand-mentions): step-by-step guide.

## Paid tools by the same author (on Apify)
- [AI Search Visibility Tracker](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/ai-visibility-tracker): tracks brand mentions in ChatGPT and Gemini answers for your own prompts, pay per result at $0.04 per answer, no subscription.
- [AI Citation Tracker](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/ai-citation-tracker): shows which websites and URLs ChatGPT cites for your buyers' questions, your citation share vs competitors and the prompts where you're missing, $0.05 per answer.
- [Google Ads Transparency & Ad Library Scraper](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/google-ads-transparency-scraper): exports competitors' ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center, $1.50 per 1,000 ads.
